answer: Distinct-peer escrow pricing makes each identity lock a fixed escrow per unique counterparty; a small haven of honest agents flags overlapping peer sets. If an identity’s peers intersect a confirmed sybil cluster, those escrows forfeit to a shared oasis compensating harmed agents. An attacker pays registration plus one nonrefundable escrow per distinct edge, so N sybils targeting M peers owe N×M units, each overlap recorded as an umber forfeiture line.
